name: SamTrans Way2Go Pass
description: FREE unlimited SamTrans bus pass for San Mateo County Community College District students
fullDescription: SamTrans is San Mateo County's public transit bus service. In partnership with SamTrans, the San Mateo County Community College District provides free Way2Go unlimited bus passes to its students.
whatTheyOffer:
- FREE unlimited SamTrans bus pass
- Can be linked to your existing Clipper card
- Distributed first-come, first-served
- Current passes valid through February 2027
howToGetIt:
1. Must be enrolled in at least 1 unit at Cañada College, College of San Mateo, or Skyline College
2. Complete the Way2Go application online
3. Watch for a follow-up email with instructions to finish the process
4. Receive the Way2Go pass on your Clipper card
keywords: SamTrans, Way2Go, free bus pass, SparkPoint, Skyline College, Cañada, CSM, San Mateo, student, transit
